title: D-024 Amendment 9 unit N: R187/R595 limited-auto activation act + first-loop operation proof
objective: Amendment 9 (R250-R260): durably record the owner's R187/R595 limited-auto activation authorization; run the complete activation preflight against the certified package (M0-T096-activation-package.md item 3) and current repository state; execute the exact certified start command with --mode limited-auto --owner-enable-bounded-auto ONLY if the repository is clean, the certified identity/configuration match, and all required gates pass; on ANY precondition mismatch stop and report the exact mismatch without improvising or partially activating; then prove operation beyond process launch and return the owner's 7-item report. Exclusions R257 remain owner-gated; 4.8 bridge stays shadow-only; certified supervisor code must not be modified before activation (R258). Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R250.
business_reason: Owner-typed R595 activation authorization 2026-08-29 (Amendment 9); activation must be preflight-verified, fail-closed, and durably evidenced.
outputs: project-control/reports/M0-T113-activation-preflight.md (preflight matrix: identity/config/gates, or the exact mismatch)
path_free_justification: Activation-act governance packet (Amendment 9, R250-R260): the unit executes the owner-authorized R595 start command and records preflight/operation evidence into NEW report files under project-control/reports/ (listed in allowed_paths; they exist only after the act). It binds no production code by design - R258 prohibits modifying certified supervisor code, and the certified identity is protected by the M0-T112 certification anchors, not by this packet's path set.
